purpose: Owner-scoped selector-semantic review for the first post-family-freeze S4 scheduler-fidelity closure batch.
policy: Only source-supported owner+selector pairs become executable. Unlisted cw721-drop selectors remain mapped-opaque. Exact semantic-conflict coverage must be recomputed; direct_gain values are prioritization evidence, not claimed cumulative gain.

reviews.mapping_basis: Verified Collection implementation ABI exposes mint(bytes16 collectionId,address user,uint16 num,uint32 nonce,bytes signature). Preserve the owner-local recipient/quantity mint dependency classes. collectionId, nonce, and signature are authorization inputs passed to the external Alba verifier, so this adapter deliberately does not invent owner-local stage/nonce storage keys; signature verification/payment policy are not claimed as native EVM equivalence.

Verified FU STUDIO MEMBERSHIP Archetype source exposes mint(Auth,uint256,address,bytes). Archetype mint forwards to mintTo(...,msg.sender,...), mints quantity to the caller, and updates per-wallet/per-invite-key state. Preserve those dependency classes; proof/signature/payment policy remain outside the scheduler model.

Existing S4 fourth-batch evidence identifies Project AEON as the same reviewed Archetype ERC721 implementation family. Verified ABI exposes the same mint(Auth,uint256,address,bytes) path, so reuse the same owner-scoped mint dependency adapter.

deferred.reason: Same selector/family signal is promising, but owner-specific verified implementation evidence was not established in this review batch; remain opaque.
